propositions: The concurrency overlay must be registered in OVERLAY_IDS enum and wired to the workflow dispatch gates (code-review.yaml) in both round_a and round_b batches to become reachable.

The content_triggered_overlays function must be extended to detect concurrency-related tokens (Mutex, Lock, Thread, async/await tasks, locks, channels, etc.) in both added and removed diff lines to fire the concurrency overlay.
The concurrency overlay must be catalogued in code-review-base.md and routed via criteria_routing.json with advisory posture (threshold 0.95, blocking disabled) and no blocking enabled.
The trigger logic must exclude noisy tokens (bare fork, Promise.all, setInterval, select) and context-only lines to maintain precision, with measured fire rate of 14% on the calibration corpus.
Registration must occur after prompt authorship so that the workflow never escalates to an overlay dimension without a corresponding reviewer implementation.
